methodology.label: Per fund: next-session open after a completed month end to the next completed-month-end-plus-one-session open, minus BIL over the same interval. Train a label only after its actual exit open occurred.
methodology.price_features: Observed21/63-session returns,63-session volatility/drawdown,SPY63-session return/volatility and fund identity.
methodology.augmented_features: Same price features plus explicitly lagged FRED term spread,real yield and63-session real-yield change, and completed-day official VIX level/VIX-to-VIX3M ratio.
methodology.training: Pooled five-fund model for the four factor funds and GLD, refit at each completed month end using at most36months of matured labels. Standardization uses training rows only; current numerical predictors are clipped to observed training ranges.
methodology.early_sample_limit: The earliest formal evaluation starts after only9distinct matured months due actual factor-fund history availability. Cross-sectional rows are not independent months. This weak early training sample is disclosed, not filled with synthetic history.
methodology.allocation: Rank four factor forecasts into fixed35/30/20/15%equity shares. The composite equity forecast and gold forecast each need expected monthly excess return above0.5%. Both positive: inverse63-session-volatility balance with30%-70%equity bounds. Only one positive: allocate70%of98%invested budget to it and the remainder toBIL. Neither positive: BIL98%.
methodology.factors: Existing economic exposures are retained; rolling coefficient/weight adaptation is not discovery of new independent economic factors.
methodology.validation: Freeze both models before outcomes. No hyperparameter search, random train/test split or future labels. Retain same10y/5y windows,actual costs,source-bound regeneration and original Sharpe/SPY/15%drawdown gates.
